rates.merchants: United tickets, upgrades, Economy Plus, inflight, bag fees
rates.note: Bought from United. Excludes third-party travel packages, some discount sites, United Cruises, Merchandise Awards.

earn.notes: After $10,000 in purchases in a calendar year, earn 6x miles on United fares as a MileagePlus member (8x total with the card 2x); it does not change the card rates listed here.

benefits.name: Checked bag certificates
benefits.notes: Two first-standard checked bag certificates after $10,000 in purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.name: 25% back on inflight
benefits.notes: 25% statement credit on food, beverage and Wi-Fi purchases on United/United Express flights and on premium drinks at United Clubs.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar month if DashPass was first activated 9/1/2026-12/31/2027 (quarterly if first activated 2/1/2025-8/31/2026), while enrolled in DashPass via the card. Source: DoorDash Chase co-brand terms; the card page does not mention DashPass.

benefits.name: DashPass membership
benefits.notes: 12 months of complimentary DashPass when first activated with the card by 12/31/2027, then auto-renews at the paid rate until cancelled. Source: DoorDash Chase co-brand terms; the United card page does not mention DashPass.

benefits.name: 10% off flights booked with miles
benefits.notes: Save 10% or more on flights booked with miles after spending $10,000 in a calendar year.
